01

“God has not made for a man two hearts in his interior”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 33:4).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
God has not made for a man two hearts in his interior [al-Ahzab 4] he said: "A man of the Banu Fihr said: 'I have two hearts within me, and with either of them I reason better than the reason of Muhammad ﷺ.' And he lied."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
مَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَيْنِ فِي جَوْفِهِ [الأحزاب: 4] قَالَ: " قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي فِهْرٍ: إِنَّ فِي جَوْفِي لَقَلْبَيْنِ أَعْقِلُ بِوَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا أَفْضَلَ مِنْ عَقْلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ وَكَذَبَ "
Edition record 373087 · p. 546Link to report ↗
02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
nor has He made your adopted sons your [true] sons [al-Ahzab 4] he said: "It was revealed about Zayd ibn Haritha, whom the Prophet ﷺ had adopted."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدْعِيَاءَكُمْ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ [الأحزاب: 4] قَالَ: «نَزَلَتْ فِي زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ تَبَنَّاهُ»
Edition record 373088 · p. 546Link to report ↗
02

“And there is no blame upon you for what you have erred in”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 33:5).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And there is no blame upon you for what you have erred in [al-Ahzab 5] he said: "This was before the prohibition in this and other matters"; but [only for] what your hearts intended [al-Ahzab 5] he said: "The deliberate is what happens after the clarification and prohibition."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا أَخْطَأْتُمْ بِهِ [الأحزاب: 5] قَالَ: «هَذَا قَبْلَ النَّهْيِ فِي هَذَا وَغَيْرِهِ» ، وَلَكِنْ مَا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ [الأحزاب: 5] قَالَ: «الْعَمْدُ مَا أَتَى بَعْدَ الْبَيَانِ وَالنَّهْيِ»
Edition record 373089 · p. 546Link to report ↗
03

“The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 33:6).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves [al-Ahzab 6] he said: "He is a father to them."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
النَّبِيُّ أَوْلَى بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ [الأحزاب: 6] قَالَ: «هُوَ أَبٌ لَهُمْ»
Edition record 373090 · p. 546Link to report ↗
05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
except that you do an act of kindness to your allies [al-Ahzab 6] he said: "meaning to your allies whom the Messenger of God made allies among the Emigrants and the Helpers ⦗p. 547⦘ with each other"; that has been in the Book inscribed [al-Isra 58] he said: "meaning the blood money and the support among them."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
إِلَّا أَنْ تَفْعَلُوا إِلَى أَوْلِيَائِكُمْ مَعْرُوفًا [الأحزاب: 6] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي إِلَى حُلَفَائِكُمُ الَّذِينَ وَالَى ⦗ص: 547⦘ بَيْنَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَالْأَنْصَارِ» ، كَانَ ذَلِكَ فِي الْكِتَابِ مَسْطُورًا [الإسراء: 58] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي الْعَقْلَ وَالنَّصْرَ بَيْنَهُمْ»
Edition record 373091 · p. 546Link to report ↗
04

“And [recall] when We took from the prophets their covenant, and from…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 33:7).

06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And [recall] when We took from the prophets their covenant, and from you [al-Ahzab 7] "meaning the Prophet ﷺ" and from Noah [al-Ahzab 7] meaning: "in the loins of Adam."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِيثَاقَهُمْ وَمِنْكَ [الأحزاب: 7] «يَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ ﷺ» ، وَمِنْ نُوحٍ [الأحزاب: 7] ، يَعْنِي: «فِي ظَهْرِ آدَمَ»
Edition record 373092 · p. 547Link to report ↗
05

“and We took from them a solemn covenant”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and We took from them a solemn covenant [al-Nisa 154] he said: "A covenant was taken from them heavier than what was taken from all the prophets, meaning those named in this verse."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِيثَاقًا غَلِيظًا [النساء: 154] قَالَ: «أَخَذَ مِنْهُمُ الْمِيثَاقَ أَغْلَظَ مِمَّا أَخَذَ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ كُلِّهِمْ، يَعْنِي مِمَّنْ سُمِّيَ فِي هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ»
Edition record 373093 · p. 547Link to report ↗

that He may question the truthful about their truthfulness [al-Ahzab 8] he said: "meaning the messengers who conveyed and delivered."

07

“when armies came to you”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 33:9).

09
Explanation from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
when armies came to you [al-Ahzab 9] he said: "The confederates: Uyayna ibn Badr, Abu Sufyan ibn Harb, and Qurayza."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ:
إِذْ جَاءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ [الأحزاب: 9] قَالَ: الْأَحْزَابُ: عُيَيْنَةُ بْنُ بَدْرٍ، وَأَبُو سُفْيَانَ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَقُرَيْظَةُ "
Edition record 373095 · p. 547Link to report ↗
10
Explanation from Mujāhid 10

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and We sent upon them a wind [al-Ahzab 9] he said: "meaning the east wind, sent upon the confederates on the day of the Trench until it overturned their cooking pots on their mouths and tore up their tents until it made them depart; and armies you did not see [al-Ahzab 9] meaning: 'the angels.'" He said: "The angels did not fight that day."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا [الأحزاب: 9] قَالَ: " يَعْنِي رِيحَ الصَّبَا أُرْسِلَتْ عَلَى الْأَحْزَابِ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ حَتَّى كَفَأَتْ قُدُورَهُمْ عَلَى أَفْوَاهِهَا وَنَزَعَتْ فَسَاطِيطَهُمْ حَتَّى أَظْعَنَتْهُمْ وَجُنُودًا لَمْ تَرَوْهَا [الأحزاب: 9] ، يَعْنِي: «الْمَلَائِكَةَ» ، قَالَ: «وَلَمْ تُقَاتِلِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ»
Edition record 373096 · p. 548Link to report ↗
08

“and from below you”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 33:10).

11
Explanation from Mujāhid 11

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
"when they came at you from above you" meaning: "Uyayna ibn Badr with the people of Najd"; and from below you [al-Ahzab 10]: "Abu Sufyan ibn Harb, and Qurayza facing you."
العربية
الإسناد

إِذْ جَاءُوكُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِكِمْ يَعْنِي: «عُيَيْنَةَ بْنَ بَدْرٍ فِي أَهْلِ نَجْدٍ» وَمَنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ [الأحزاب: 10] «أَبُو سُفْيَانَ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَمُوَاجَهَتُكُمْ قُرَيْظَةُ»

10

“And when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 33:12).

13
Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said [al-Ahzab 12]: "It spoke to them of hypocrisy that day and spoke to the believers of truth and faith; they said: 'This is what God and His Messenger promised us.'"
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَإِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ [الأحزاب: 12] " تُكَلِّمُهُمْ بِالنِّفَاقِ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَتُكَلِّمُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِالْحَقِّ وَالْإِيمَانِ، فَقَالُوا: هَذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ "
Edition record 373099 · p. 548Link to report ↗

27

“O you who have believed, do not be like those who harmed Moses; then…”

An explanation transmitted from Abū Hurayra (Q 33:69).

34
Explanation from Abū Hurayra 34

Abū Hurayra

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Shayban related to us, from Ikrima, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
The Messenger of God recited O you who have believed, do not be like those who harmed Moses; then God cleared him of what they said [al-Ahzab 69], and said: "The Children of Israel used to say that Moses had a scrotal hernia. So Moses went to the river and bathed, and placed his clothes on a rock, and the rock ran off with his clothes." Abu Hurayra said: "It is as if I can see the Prophet narrating: 'Moses moved his hands and said: My clothes, O rock! My clothes, O rock!' He passed by the Children of Israel, and they looked and saw nothing."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ آذَوْا مُوسَى فَبَرَّأَهُ اللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوا [الأحزاب: 69] فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ مُوسَى آدَرُ، فَانْطَلَقَ مُوسَى إِلَى النَّهَرِ، فَاغْتَسَلَ، وَوَضَعَ ثِيَابَهُ عَلَى حَجَرٍ فَاشْتَدَّ الْحَجَرُ بِثِيَابِهِ» ، قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ: فَلَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ يَحْكِي: " مُوسَى يُحَرِّكُ يَدَيْهِ، وَيَقُولُ: ثِيَابِي يَا حَجَرُ، ثِيَابِي يَا حَجَرُ، فَمَرَّ عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فَنَظَرُوا فَلَمْ يَرَوْا شَيْئًا "

28

“a word of appropriate justice”

An explanation transmitted from al-Ḥasan.

35
Explanation from al-Ḥasan 35

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from al-Hasan, on His words:
a word of appropriate justice [al-Nisa 9] meaning: "truth." Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said: "meaning a straight word."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا [النساء: 9] ، يَعْنِي: «صِدْقًا» . أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: «يَعْنِي قَوْلًا سِدَادًا»
